site.headline:
The Art of Sight.
The Science of Intelligence.
site.lede: Still, aerial, and moving image — observed, then understood. A quiet instrument for pictures that remember how light behaved.
site.title: VIXL
site.description: VIXL — Visual Excellence Lab. Still, aerial, and moving image. Observed, then understood.

studio.headline:
Pictures first.
Intelligence after.
paragraphs: VIXL is a small studio for still, aerial, and moving image. We make pictures that remember how light behaved — then we ask a model to read them. Not to replace the eye. To give the frame a second, slower look.
The interface is meant to disappear. Black field, tight type, the work in the clear. Camera notes stay in the catalog; the lab writes a cinematic title and a search line only when you ask.

pillars.d: Large format, rangefinder, cinema stills. One frame, held.
Drone studies of land that already composed itself.
Muted loops. Almost still. The horizon as a temperature.

threshold-of-light.title: Threshold of Light
threshold-of-light.description: Basalt falling into the North Atlantic at the last usable hour. The water holds a colder green than the sky will admit.

coast-drifting.title: Coast, Drifting
coast-drifting.description: A single push over the cliff line at dawn. Almost still. The horizon is a temperature, not a line.

the-last-rehearsal.title: The Last Rehearsal
the-last-rehearsal.description: One tungsten source. A body and a length of silk in the same second. The face is not the subject; the light is.

after-the-rain.title: After the Rain
after-the-rain.description: An emptied boulevard writing the city back onto itself. Sodium, a red sign, and the wet as a second street.

geometry-of-wind.title: Geometry of Wind
geometry-of-wind.description: Ridges drawn overnight. From the air the desert is a drafting table — ochre, rust, and a blue that only exists in shadow.

one-window.title: One Window
one-window.description: Blue hour on poured concrete. A single occupied room. The plaza is a mirror the building has not asked for.

first-weather.title: First Weather
first-weather.description: Fog thick enough to be a material. Light finds the trunks the way a hand finds a banister in the dark.

the-witness.title: The Witness
the-witness.description: A figure at glass, face withheld. The city arrives as color, not architecture. Interior as exposure, not room.

alpenglow.title: Alpenglow
alpenglow.description: First light on a winter ridge. The peak takes the sun; the valley keeps the night a little longer.

lantern-hour.title: Lantern Hour
lantern-hour.description: A backstreet after rain. Paper light, black water, steam. The alley is empty on purpose.

caustic.title: Caustic
caustic.description: Cut glass and a single beam. The subject is not the vessel — it is the light that has to go through it.

undertow.title: Undertow
undertow.description: From below the break. The surface is a ceiling of white fire; everything under it is a held breath.

night-glass.title: Night, Glass
night-glass.description: Rain rehearsing on a dark pane. The city stays out of focus, which is how a city should behave at this hour.
